title: Different mall?
content: Just now, I woke up from a nap. The nap included a dream about being inside a semi empty mall. Some stores being makeup, fashion, books, etc. They are scattered. I was with my mom for some of it. Then I got shown a world map, and how I was brought to different malls around the world? More specifically in the upper South America area? Strange. Also remember being at a makeup store, where I was looking at lip liners (which were like $1,200 each?). Then all that happened. It was super weird. The mall prior to being brought to other places was in a city I never been, remember driving there. Remember just being teleported inside, not walking in. Hmm.
